title: NHL Logo Quiz Part 2: Hard Mode
headline: NHL Logo Quiz Part 2: Name The Team From A Tiny Piece Of Its Logo
description: A hard NHL logo quiz: eight tiny pieces of NHL team logos, about 2% of each logo. Guess the team, tap to reveal the answer, keep score and share your result.
intro: Every piece below is a small square cut from a current NHL team logo, about one fiftieth of the whole mark. No full letters, no team names, no giveaways. Each piece still holds one real detail, a color pair, a curve or an edge that belongs to only one team.
Make your guess, then tap Show The Answer. Be honest and mark whether you got it, and your score adds up at the bottom.

readMore.label: How Every NHL Team Got Its Name

items.piece: The gold hand guard of one of the crossed sabres, against blue.
items.fact: The buffalo and crossed sabres went back to royal blue and gold for the 2020-21 season, ending the navy look the Sabres wore from 2006.

items.piece: A gold-edged tongue of flame, against red.
items.fact: When the team moved from Atlanta to Calgary in 1980, it kept the Flames name and changed the logo from a flaming A to a flaming C.

items.piece: The silver and black swirl at the lower left of the storm.
items.fact: The Hurricanes' logo is a version of the weather symbol for a hurricane, and the eye of the storm looks like a puck.

items.piece: Part of a hockey stick: black, white and orange stripes.
items.fact: The Ducks unveiled a refreshed version of the 1993 Mighty Ducks duck face at the 2024 NHL Draft, in a new orange-heavy palette.

items.piece: Blue and white swirl at the lower right, near the puck.
items.fact: The Avalanche logo dates to the team's first season in 1995. The A doubles as a mountain peak, wrapped in a swirl of snow led by a puck.

items.piece: The green edge and black of the star's right point.
items.fact: The Stars unveiled a D inside a star in June 2013, along with the new Victory Green color.

items.piece: A silver star point against navy, with a red stripe.
items.fact: The Blue Jackets' logo since 2007 is the Ohio state flag curled into a C. The star in the middle marks Columbus as the state capital.

items.piece: The gold outline at the top left corner of the B, with black inside.
items.fact: The Bruins unveiled a refreshed spoked B in June 2025, with dark and light versions for home and road.
